title: Jason Sands: they want their stuff back

tellings.quote: they want their stuff back and they're going to kill everybody involved in the program if they don't get it.

plain: A man named Jason Sands, who says he worked near a secret program holding recovered non-human craft, is said to have warned that "they want their stuff back and they're going to kill everybody involved in the program if they don't get it." Michels repeats this from Sands's appearance on Joe Rogan's show. It would mean whoever owns the craft is willing to use deadly force to get them back.
